sections.Profile:
Guided by Ash Williams, voiced by Bruce Campbell, players fight the Deadites of The Evil Dead and Evil Dead 2: Dead by Dawn, all the way down to a fruit cellar lower playfield. Spooky Pinball's 13th game, it was designed by Corwin "Bug" Emery and Spooky Luke and revealed in November 2024.

- Manufacturer: Spooky Pinball LLC
- Years made: 2024
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Zombies, Violence, Death, 2020s, Licensed, Solid State, Movie, Horror
